third_party_assets.name: MakeHuman base mesh (hm08), modelling targets, helper geometry and game_engine rig with weights
third_party_assets.source: Bundled with MPFB 2: src/mpfb/data/3dobjs, targets, rigs/standard/rig.game_engine.json, weights.game_engine.json
third_party_assets.used_for: Body, face, hands and feet of all four characters; skeleton (53 bones) and skin weights
third_party_assets.modifications: Per-character macro and detail targets, uniform scale to the wanted height, helper and joint geometry removed, skin hidden under the tunic deleted, raised 13 mm onto the sandal soles

third_party_assets.name: makehuman_system_assets (asset pack)
third_party_assets.authors: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier (copyright holders named in every asset file at the 2020 CC0 release)
third_party_assets.license: CC0-1.0, stated in each used .mhclo/.mhmat header and in packs/makehuman_system_assets.json
third_party_assets.modifications: Skins: saturation and tint towards a sun-exposed tone, added procedural pore and tone variation, painted beard and brow shading, saved as 2K JPEG. Eyes: desaturated, resized to 512. Hair and brows: recoloured (optionally greyed), resized to 1024/512; hair meshes trimmed at the hairline and under helmets.

original_project_work: Tunic, belt, sandals, layered beard shells, cap/helmet, shield and spear geometry (art_source/characters/bq_garments.py)
Idle, guard, walk, run and jump animation clips, authored by script with analytic leg IK, no motion capture (bq_anim.py)
Woven cloth, leather, bronze, beard strand and skin variation textures, generated procedurally (bq_textures.py)
Character proportions, faces and colour choices (build_characters.py)
historical_note: Tunics, belts, sandals, caps, round shields and spears are an artistic interpretation of an Iron Age Levantine setting, not an archaeological reconstruction.
project_polish_2026_11_12: Fringe-only subdivision and smoothed trim boundary; existing CC0 hairstyle sources unchanged.
Original elongated beard-strand texture generator, fewer and shorter shells, darker grey strands.
Adjusted skin roughness/specular; no new external textures or licences.
Godot head-attention modifier, original project code.
